compare_rows.label: Market cap
compare_rows.definition: Price × shares outstanding on the price date.

compare_rows.label: Revenue growth (compound, a year)
compare_rows.definition: Compound annual growth of revenue over the years shown.

compare_rows.label: Operating margin
compare_rows.definition: EBIT ÷ revenue, after depreciation, excluding other income.

compare_rows.label: Return on invested capital
compare_rows.definition: After-tax EBIT ÷ invested capital at the start of the year.

compare_rows.label: Return on equity
compare_rows.definition: Profit for the year ÷ total equity at year end.

compare_rows.label: Cash conversion
compare_rows.definition: Operating cash flow ÷ profit for the year.

compare_rows.label: Free cash flow to the firm
compare_rows.definition: After-tax EBIT less the change in invested capital, last full year.

compare_rows.label: P/E (TTM)
compare_rows.definition: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four reported quarters.

compare_rows.label: EV / EBIT (TTM)
compare_rows.definition: Enterprise value ÷ operating profit over the last four quarters.

compare_rows.label: Beta vs NIFTY 50
compare_rows.definition: Sensitivity of the daily return to the NIFTY 50's.

compare_rows.label: Growth the price implies
compare_rows.definition: The reverse DCF: revenue growth for five years that the price is consistent with.

compare_rows.label: DCF template
compare_rows.definition: Which template applies (A: positive free cash flow; B: reinvestment earning above its cost), and why not when neither does.

bar_scale_note: Bars share one scale for every company, 0 to 60% a year. An open-ended bar means the price lies beyond the range the model searches.
